comparison.objective: Remove, clear, and reinstall a rocking deck board.
comparison.physical_skill: Using the board as a lever, coordinated lifting, debris removal, and close-fit reinsertion.
comparison.success_condition: Pebble in the bucket earns partial credit; full credit requires the board reinstalled flush.
comparison.reason: Lever-assisted extraction and reinsertion differ from concentric countertorque on adjustment hardware.
